title: Understand the role and set up your tools
tasks: Read the Start Here lessons on the Data Analyst role and the 12-week plan
Install VS Code, Git and test Excel
Create a GitHub account and push a first repository
Log your hours on the Dashboard

title: First SQL queries
tasks: Learn what a database, table, row and column are
Open the SQL playground and explore a dataset
Write 10 simple SELECT queries
Do 5 easy practice questions

title: Filtering rows with WHERE
tasks: Learn WHERE with comparison operators, AND, OR, IN, BETWEEN
Write 10 filter queries
Do 8 easy practice questions

title: Excel basics and data types
tasks: Learn the Excel interface, shortcuts, data types and formatting
Practise SUM, AVERAGE, COUNT, MIN and MAX
Finish 8 easy Excel practice tasks

title: Sorting, limiting and Excel cleaning
tasks: Learn ORDER BY, LIMIT and DISTINCT in SQL
Learn TRIM, Remove Duplicates and Find and Replace in Excel
Do 8 SQL and 4 Excel practice questions

title: NULLs, mini project start, and study habits
tasks: Learn NULL handling and IS NULL
Read the study-effectively lesson and start your error log
Start Mini Project 1: choose a dataset and write 3 business questions
Do 8 mixed SQL questions

title: Revision and mock test
tasks: Redo every question you got wrong this week
Take a timed 30-45 minute mock on this week's topics
Update your error log and log your study hours
Plan next week: aggregates and Excel formulas

title: SQL aggregate functions
tasks: Learn COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX
Write 10 aggregate queries
Do 8 practice questions

title: GROUP BY and HAVING
tasks: Learn GROUP BY with aggregates and HAVING vs WHERE
Write 10 grouped queries on the practice datasets
Do 8 practice questions

title: Excel logical and text functions
tasks: Learn IF, IFS, AND, OR
Learn text functions such as LEFT, RIGHT, MID, TEXTJOIN and Flash Fill
Do 8 Excel practice tasks

title: CASE WHEN and string functions in SQL
tasks: Learn CASE WHEN for categories
Learn UPPER, LOWER, SUBSTR, LIKE and REPLACE in SQLite
Do 10 practice questions

title: Excel pivot tables
tasks: Build pivot tables, pivot charts and slicers
Summarise a sales sheet by city and month
Do 6 Excel practice tasks

title: Date functions and mixed practice
tasks: Learn SQL date functions with strftime
Learn Excel date functions
Do 12 mixed practice questions and continue Mini Project 1

title: Revision and mock test
tasks: Redo every question you got wrong this week
Take a timed 30-45 minute mock on this week's topics
Update your error log and log your study hours
Plan next week: joins and Excel lookups

title: SQL INNER JOIN
tasks: Learn why data is split across tables and how keys connect them
Write 10 INNER JOIN queries
Do 8 practice questions

title: LEFT JOIN and finding missing rows
tasks: Learn LEFT JOIN and the anti-join pattern
Find customers who never ordered
Do 8 practice questions

title: Excel lookups
tasks: Learn VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP and INDEX-MATCH
Merge two sheets with a lookup
Do 8 Excel practice tasks

title: More joins: multi-table, self and cross
tasks: Join three tables in one query
Learn SELF JOIN and CROSS JOIN with an example each
Do 8 practice questions

title: Excel conditional sums and charts
tasks: Learn SUMIFS, COUNTIFS and AVERAGEIFS
Build clear charts and use conditional formatting
Do 6 Excel practice tasks

title: Mixed join practice and mini project
tasks: Do 15 mixed join and aggregate questions
Write your project questions as SQL and save the queries to GitHub

title: Revision and mock test
tasks: Redo every question you got wrong this week
Take a timed 30-45 minute mock on this week's topics
Update your error log and log your study hours
Plan next week: subqueries and CTEs

title: SQL subqueries
tasks: Learn subqueries in WHERE, FROM and SELECT
Do 10 practice questions

title: CTEs and set operations
tasks: Learn WITH, how to break a problem into steps, UNION and INTERSECT
Rewrite two subqueries as CTEs
Do 8 practice questions

title: Excel dashboard building
tasks: Build an Excel dashboard with pivots, charts and slicers
Apply data validation and what-if analysis basics

title: SQL data cleaning and deduplication
tasks: Learn COALESCE, TRIM, duplicates and ROW_NUMBER for dedup preview
Do 10 practice questions

title: Excel Power Query basics and test tasks
tasks: Clean a messy file with Power Query
Practise common Excel test tasks under a 30-minute timer

title: First SQL screening test
tasks: Take a timed SQL test: 5 questions in 45 minutes
Review each mistake in your error log
Finish Mini Project 1 and write its README

title: Revision and mock test
tasks: Redo every question you got wrong this week
Take a timed 30-45 minute mock on this week's topics
Update your error log and log your study hours
Plan next week: window functions and Power BI start

title: SQL window functions and Power BI begins
tasks: Days 1-3: ROW_NUMBER, RANK, DENSE_RANK, LAG, LEAD, running totals (10 questions a day)
Days 4-5: install Power BI Desktop, load data, learn Power Query basics
Day 6: first SQL interview patterns (top N per group, second highest)
Day 7: revision and timed SQL test
Create a one-page resume draft

title: Power BI modelling and DAX, Python starts, applications begin
tasks: Days 1-3: star schema, relationships, measures, CALCULATE and time intelligence
Day 4: build and publish Dashboard 1 (screenshots to GitHub)
Days 5-6: Python basics, setup Jupyter and pandas
Day 7: revision and mock
Start applying: 10 tailored applications this week and set up the tracker

title: Python pandas and Project 1
tasks: Days 1-3: pandas DataFrames, filtering, groupby, merge, missing values
Days 4-6: start Project 1 (clean and analyse a dataset with SQL and Python)
Day 7: revision and mock
Apply to 10-15 jobs and message 3 alumni

title: Python visualisation and statistics begins
tasks: Days 1-2: matplotlib and seaborn charts
Days 3-5: descriptive statistics, distributions, normal curve, z-scores, outliers
Day 6: finish and publish Project 1 with a README
Day 7: revision and mock
Continue 10-15 applications and one SQL timed test

title: Statistics, A/B testing and business case thinking; Project 2
tasks: Days 1-2: sampling, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing, p-values
Day 3: A/B test end to end
Days 4-5: business metrics and structured case answers (fintech first)
Day 6: start Project 2 (dashboard project in Power BI)
Day 7: revision and mock case
Keep applying

title: Project 3 and SQL interview patterns
tasks: Days 1-3: SQL interview patterns (retention, cohorts, funnels, gaps and islands, percent of total)
Days 4-6: build Project 3 (end-to-end analysis with SQL, Python and a short report)
Day 7: revision and a full mock interview
10-15 applications and follow-ups

title: Interview preparation, project polish and applications
tasks: Days 1-2: polish GitHub profile, READMEs and LinkedIn
Days 3-4: practise HR questions, your project story and the resume pitch
Days 5-6: aptitude practice and timed Excel and SQL tests
Day 7: two mock interviews
20 applications this week and follow up on old ones

title: Final mock week
tasks: Day 1-2: full timed SQL test and Excel task
Day 3: Power BI practical test (90 minutes)
Day 4: business case mock
Day 5: technical plus HR mock interview
Day 6: fix your top three weak areas
Day 7: review the 12 weeks, plan the next month and keep applying daily
